entities.name: Query protein 164c1d
observations: 459-aa protein; calculated mass 51.13 kDa and theoretical pI 9.27 from sequence analysis.
Pfam detects Shikimate_dh_N PF08501 at residues 20–101 and SKI PF01202 at residues 306–443.
Top Swiss-Prot hits are AroE-labeled proteins at 35.5–40.4% identity, aligning chiefly to query residues 11–289; the annotation tool did not transfer a definitive function.
Combined domain and homology evidence suggests a fused shikimate dehydrogenase–shikimate kinase candidate; catalytic activity and cofactor specificity are unconfirmed.

entities.name: Shikimate pathway
observations: Candidate pathway context inferred from an N-terminal shikimate dehydrogenase-like domain and C-terminal shikimate kinase-like domain; not directly assigned by curated annotation in the sequence report.
